resolved_literal_pools.resolution_method: Hand pc-relative arithmetic against each .s file's own instruction stream, cross-checked with `arm-none-eabi-as -mthumb` + `arm-none-eabi-ld -Ttext=<addr>` + `objdump -d --adjust-vma=<addr>` standalone reassembly of each region. Caveat: the reassembly widened the two 080dd9c0.s branches to .set absolute symbols (bne/b to sub_080dda3c) into 4-byte bne.w/b.w forms, which shifts the tool's own computed addresses for the final BG2X pool pair by 4 bytes versus the ROM's real narrow encoding; the given LiteralPool_080dda18 label position (consistent with narrow branches, i.e. the real ROM encoding) was used as ground truth for that pair instead of the widened reassembly's arithmetic. 080dda3c.s and 080ddb34.s branch only to near local labels (no cross-file .set targets before the pool), so their reassembly address arithmetic is trusted directly.
